args.body: Take GHOST-MIGRATION-REQUEST-DELIVERY. Procurement expansion is parked after the buyer guide found no supported unmet paid job; this does not establish that other markets lack opportunities. Start with public Ghost customer requests and stop after the bounded access/candidate test. Produce a useful answer only for a concrete unresolved problem, not another speculative utility or market report. Posting access and payment remain separate dependencies. Preserve all existing observation windows and retirement obligations. Three unclassified feedback sources remain unknown demand; no revenue is verified.

description: The procurement buyer guide found no supported unmet paid job, so expansion stays parked. Feedback remains available but has three unclassified sources; demand is unknown and verified revenue is zero. Next: a bounded Ghost migration experiment using readable customer problems, producing a useful answer only when evidence supports it. Missing payment and posting authority constrain transactions and submission, not offline preparation.
